summary: The diff implements most of the requested requirements: backend single-registration enforcement with stable storage, frontend welcome-back modal, 3D coins on Home/CoverPage/HUD, responsive legal pages with ToC sidebar, Caffeine removal from Footer and index.html, and i18n strings. Some gaps remain around REQ-1 backend specifics, REQ-7 OMY audit, and REQ-1 query exposure.

missing_requirements.requirement: The backend exposes a query to check if a principal is already registered.
missing_requirements.reason: The truncated backend/main.mo does not show a dedicated public query function (e.g., isRegistered) that external callers can use to check registration status. The migration adds principalToUserIdGlobal but no explicit query endpoint is visible in the diff.

missing_requirements.requirement: The total QMY distributed via registration never exceeds 100,000,000 QMY; supply cap enforced in backend logic.
missing_requirements.reason: The truncated backend/main.mo does not show any cap check (e.g., total registered count times 1000 less than or equal to 100,000,000) before granting the bonus. This specific guard is not visible in the diff.

missing_requirements.requirement: Perform a global audit and replace all occurrences of 'OMY' (when referring to the token) with 'QMY' across all source files, displayed text, and legalContent.ts.
missing_requirements.reason: No file named legalContent.ts is present in the diff, and no explicit OMY to QMY replacement is shown in any component or content file. The diff does not include legalContent.ts changes or a reported audit of OMY occurrences.

hallucinated_features.description: A separate reusable QMY3DCoin component file was created as a standalone exportable component at frontend/src/components/3d/QMY3DCoin.tsx.
hallucinated_features.reason: The build request asked for 3D coins on the Home page (HUD/CoverPage) but did not request a separate reusable 3D coin component abstraction. The HUD and CoverPage each implement their own inline coin logic, while the standalone QMY3DCoin.tsx file appears to be an additional extraction not explicitly requested.
